[Internal Technical Instruction - Must Comply]
1. Keep technical placeholders like %%VAR_n%%, %%MC_n%%, %%HEX_n%% exactly as they are (do not modify, translate, or add/remove tags).

3. All other text contents MUST be translated and not output as is.
